nodes.name: On any workflow error
nodes.notes: Set as the Error Workflow in the settings of Orchestrator, Stage Runner, Cohort Loop and Notify.

nodes.name: Extract the failure
nodes.notes: Recovers month/runId from execution.customData, then $vars.RBL_MONTH, then last month. Builds the quoted release command.

nodes.name: Release the lock
nodes.notes: Releases the month lock and records {crashedAt, node, message} into state/<month>.json. Never allowed to stop the notification: an unreleased lock is bad, an unreported crash is worse. The command is wrapped so the shell always exits 0 and the real code travels in stdout as __EXIT__<code>. Measured on n8n 2.35.7: this node reports exitCode ONLY when the command exits 0 — on any non-zero exit it emits { error } alone, dropping both exitCode and stdout, with the stderr text as the message. That makes an exit 10 (a human must decide) indistinguishable from a crash, and loses the JSON line the contract is built on. onError:continueRegularOutput keeps the workflow running but does not restore the fields.

nodes.name: Did the lock come off?
nodes.notes: If the lock is still held, the alert says so and gives the command to clear it.

nodes.name: Notify at fail
nodes.notes: Import RBL · Notify first — this node needs its ID to exist.
